messages:
maria: Heads-up — after merging the FP8 attention kernels yesterday we saw a perf regression on some long-sequence workloads. Posting initial findings and discussing SDK knobs to mitigate.

bench-bot: Automated perf report:
model=redwood/rw-40b, seq=2048, batch=1, old-kernel=attn_fp16, new-kernel=attn_fp8
- tokens/s old: 18500
- tokens/s new: 16200 (-12.4%)
- p95 latency old: 98ms -> new: 112ms
- KV cache hit-rate: 98% (unchanged)
- Quant calibration: samples=512, method=KL

chris: Looks sequence-length dependent. Regression grows with seq length. My hunch: kernel selector picks fp8 matmul path but attention loop falls back to slower path when KV cache > 1 shard.

vikram: Two parallel actions: (1) tighten kernel selection heuristics to prefer fp16 attn for seq>1024 when kv_cache_shards>1; (2) expose an SDK/console knob so users can force kernel hints per-model while we iterate.

maria: I want both too. Immediate SDK knob for customers + longer-term selector fix. Proposed SDK param names: quant.kernel_hint (auto|force_fp8|force_fp16|force_int8), quant.calibration_samples, quant.calibration_method, quant.preset. Also a fallback_policy param.

amelia: Docs + quickstart should show safety rails (automatic fallbacks, perf/quality deltas). Example snippet to add to SDK docs:

```python
# safe-ish example: prefer mixed quant but allow fallback to fp16 on perf regressions
client.generate(
  model="rw-40b",
  input="...",
  quant={
    "mode": "mixed",
    "bits": 8,
    "calibration_samples": 1024,
    "calibration_method": "KL",
    "kernel_hint": "auto",
    "preset": "cost-optimized"
  },
  batching={
    "max_batch": 8,
    "timeout_ms": 15
  },
  fallback_policy={
    "on_perf_drop": "fallback_to_fp16",
    "on_quality_drop": "halt_and_notify"
  }
)
```

vikram: Add a "safe" preset that expands to: kernel_hint=force_fp16, calibration_samples=2048, enable_sanity_checks=true. And a "aggressive" preset that sets kernel_hint=force_fp8, calibrate_dry_run=false.

chris: We should also expose telemetry hooks so users can run calibration dry-runs: quant.calibrate_dry_run=true and quant.profile_id to link console traces.

bench-bot: Quick calibration summary (from nightly cal job):
- samples=1024, method=KL -> latency +3%, perplexity +0.2
- samples=2048 -> latency +6%, perplexity +0.05
- int8 preset -> throughput x1.9, perplexity +0.6

maria: Those deltas look reasonable but we must surface them prominently in docs and Console before enabling auto-rollout. Also add an opt-in safety rail: "do_not_switch_kernels_during_rollout" that locks kernel selection for canaries.

deploy-bot: canary deploy queued for quant-sdk-knobs v1.0 at 23:00 UTC :rocket:

amelia: I'll draft a quickstart page: "Quantization knobs and safety presets" with examples, perf table and recommended defaults based on seq length and kv cache size.

chris: Filing ENG-RUNTIME-214 to update kernel selector heuristics and add unit tests for long-seq + multi-shard KV cache.

maria: Thanks — small action items: (a) vikram to draft SDK PR for knobs + presets, (b) amelia to draft docs + quickstart, (c) chris to file selector task. Paste bench traces/links here if you have them.

vikram: perf trace: https://internal.perf/trace/1768004321-quant-fp8-kernel

bench-bot: Artifacts: /artifacts/1768004321/trace.zip

maria: OK wrapping up. We'll use the SDK knob as the short-term mitigation and roll heuristic fix through canary. Ping me on PRs. :white_check_mark:
